summary: Operator site read: 75 full-hookup sites, indoor bathhouse, laundry, playground, go-karts/mini golf/arcade; 'We're Closed for 2026! ... seeing you in May 2027!' (seasonal). No rates, amperage or exact season dates posted.
flags: Price: no rate posted on the operator's site; price indicator is the RV Life $$ tier only. Presence passes: working website with phone 218-681-7066 (matches the entry; off-season number 218-653-1105) and Google 4.4 (112 reviews). No gateway within 40 km.

Booking: the site says 'We pride ourselves on our no-reservation-required policy' and 'Call us today'; stored reservable false / FCFS always left as derived (the wording does not say reservations are refused).

Long-stay character: not evident from the operator's pages (no monthly/seasonal rates advertised); recent Google reviews read are about the go-karts and mini golf. Imagery shows ~75 pads in rows north of the fun park, many occupied, but no residential fixtures were judged.
Pin 48.12371,-96.21064 is on the entrance drive ~130 m south of the RV rows: OK. Not waterfront: confirmed (farmland and highway, no water).
note: Family fun-park campground on US-59 at Thief River Falls (est. 2010) with a playground, go-kart track, mini golf and an arcade open to the public. --Claude
